tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background behind grouped lists and cards (the systemGroupedBackground role). Asphalt-grey, never cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped list rows, cards, marker discs and name capsules on the map.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tiles and neutral buttons inside a card or sheet, segmented-control tracks, status pills for neutral states.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on ground, surface, surface-raised and glass-fill, including plain, text and back buttons in the app. Also the distance capsule fill, with ground text on it, and the dashed connector line between two people at 60% opacity.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text (subtitles, row details, timestamps) on ground, surface, surface-raised and glass-fill.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hints and placeholder text on ground, surface and surface-raised; the dashed ring of a last-seen marker (3:1 or more on every map color).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline between list rows, inset to the text. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: lamplight
tokens.usage: The sharer: their marker ring, their trail dots in dark (full opacity, 3:1 or more on every map color), and the prominent Share button fill. Sodium streetlight amber. Text on it is on-lamplight. Never the app's tint for anything else.

tokens.name: on-lamplight
tokens.usage: Labels and glyphs on a lamplight fill. Never put white on lamplight. Also the 1pt keyline outside the sharer marker's ring, which holds the marker at 3:1 on light map colors.

tokens.name: lamplight-text
tokens.usage: Sharer-colored text on surface, ground and lamplight-wash: the sharer's Live status, LIVE badges. Also the sharer's trail dots in light (full opacity, 3:1 or more on every map color) and the selected mascot tile's border.

tokens.name: lamplight-wash
tokens.usage: Soft background for sharer badges and pills, with lamplight-text on it.

tokens.name: lamplight-halo
tokens.usage: The soft 80pt halo behind a live sharer marker on the map, and the circle 1 km across around an approximate sharer.

tokens.name: crossing
tokens.usage: The viewer, the person following along: their marker disc and the browser page's Share my location button. Crossing-signal blue. Text on it is on-crossing. Never the sharer app's tint.

tokens.name: on-crossing
tokens.usage: The viewer's initial and button labels on a crossing fill.

tokens.name: crossing-text
tokens.usage: Viewer-colored text on surface, ground and crossing-wash, on both people's screens; plain text buttons on the browser page.

tokens.name: crossing-wash
tokens.usage: Soft background for viewer pills and the share-back card, with crossing-text on it.

tokens.name: crossing-halo
tokens.usage: The soft 72pt halo behind a live viewer marker on the map.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Solid fill for the confirm button of a destructive alert only (Stop sharing?, Delete account). Text on it is on-flare.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Labels on a flare fill.

tokens.name: flare-text
tokens.usage: Destructive text on surface, ground and flare-wash: Stop sharing, Delete account and all data.

tokens.name: flare-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the tinted Stop sharing button, with flare-text on it.

tokens.name: connected
tokens.usage: Call state only: the On a call dot and text, and Back to call (Android only). Text on surface, ground and connected-wash. Never used for success.

tokens.name: connected-wash
tokens.usage: Background of call-state pills, with connected text on it.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Custom Liquid Glass fill for floating controls over the map on the web page. Native iOS uses the system glass material instead. Holds ink and ink-secondary text.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge around custom glass. iOS 27 separates glass with a defined edge, not a drop shadow.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: 1px specular line along the top inside edge of custom glass.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3pt solid keyboard and switch-control focus ring, 2pt outside the control. At least 3:1 on ground, surface and map-land in both themes.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map base. Also the background behind map previews.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Minor streets on the map.

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: Main roads: warm, like streets under sodium lights.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Parks and green space on the map.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Rivers, lakes and sea on the map.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Street and place labels on every map color, in caption-2: 11pt or larger, growing with the text size. Holds 4.5:1 on all map colors in both themes. Hidden in mini maps and thumbnails.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The one big title at the top of Home and the share screen. Gabarito Bold, bundled in the app and scaled with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles on pushed screens. Gabarito Bold, scaled with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Sheet titles over the map. Gabarito Bold, scaled with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: title-3
styles.sample: Alex is sharing their location with you
styles.usage: Section heads and the viewer page's heading. iOS: .title3.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Button labels and list row titles. iOS: .headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The person you're talking to follows you live in their browser.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Sheet subtitles and explanations under a title. iOS: .callout.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: List row details and status text. iOS: .subheadline.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Your browser will ask for permission first.
styles.usage: Small print under buttons and inside pills. iOS: .footnote.

styles.name: caption-1
styles.usage: Name capsules under map markers. iOS: .caption with medium weight.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: The smallest allowed text: map labels only, never below 11pt, growing with the text size. Sentence case or the place's own name, never uppercase. iOS: .caption2.

styles.name: distance
styles.usage: The big distance on the Live Activity and stat tiles. Gabarito Bold; tabular figures on iOS come from SF Pro with .monospacedDigit().

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Numbers inline: the distance capsule on the map, call timers.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Uppercase status badges (LIVE, LIVE TOGETHER, NO SIGNAL, NO CONNECTION). The only uppercase text anywhere.

spacing.note: There is no space-7: the scale goes from space-6 (24) straight to space-8 (32).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a pill; half-step of the 8pt grid.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inset of floating sheets and bars from the screen edge; gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between an avatar and its text in a row; padding inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen margins on standard phones; list row side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margins on larger phones; padding inside map sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a screen's primary action when the screen has room.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable: 44pt on iOS.

tokens.name: tap-target-lg
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable on Android (48dp) and on the viewer's browser page (48px).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small thumbnails and keycap-sized elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles and neutral buttons inside a map sheet (radius-sheet minus 20pt padding, so corners stay concentric).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Grouped lists, cards and map previews.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Floating sheets and the picture-in-picture mini map, following the device's corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills, name capsules and the distance capsule.

android.note: Documentation only: Material 3 corner radii for the Android app, in dp (written as px like the rest of this file). Not built into tokens.css.

tokens.name: android-radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: android-radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and modal bottom sheets.

tokens.name: android-radius-list-outer
tokens.usage: Outer corners of a grouped list (first and last rows).

tokens.name: android-radius-list-inner
tokens.usage: Inner corners between rows of a grouped list, with 2dp gaps.

tokens.name: android-radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields.

tokens.name: android-radius-pressed
tokens.usage: Buttons while pressed; they morph from fully round at rest.

shadow.note: Shadows go on three things only: markers (shadow-marker), the floating mini map (shadow-float) and Android's system stand-ins (a soft shadow of their own). Never on glass, which separates with glass-edge.

tokens.name: shadow-marker
tokens.usage: Person markers on the map.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The Android picture-in-picture mini map floating over the call screen.
